description: Expected bytes are derived by hand from the rule text. Cross-implementation byte-identity may be claimed only for the machine artefacts, a claim listing HTML in that set is rejected and the rest of the claim stands (AGSC-04-24; HTML is deterministic within one implementation only, AGSC-04-01). Every route is written once and only in the AGSC-06-01 route form, leading slash included, so no port has to guess whether the slash is significant. Order is the claim's own order, preserved.

expected.reason: HTML is deterministic within one implementation only (AGSC-04-01)
expected.route_form: AGSC-06-01, leading slash on every entry
